args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (including `tests/test_money.py`).
